snippet.title: Bounty Star Release Date Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
An action-packed trailer for Dinogod's mech Western Bounty Star revealed that the game is coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on October 23rd.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
